title: Compose Service Classification Catalogue
description: Durable semantic service catalogue and CMDB-style foundation asset for Compose service classification, owner/risk/control metadata, environment disposition, generated Compose targets, and explicit readiness non-claims. Generated Compose files are derivative; this catalogue is authoritative for service disposition.
aiGuidance: Classify every historical React Compose service before deriving Compose. Do not treat generated Compose as authority or infer production readiness from it. Treat service-level owner, risk, control, evidence, ISO-supporting, enterprise-supporting, and readiness-claim metadata as required governance metadata, not generated inventory text.
